evidence.detail: Exact v308 constructs configs/wandering_merchant.yaml (or compiled configs/w.bin) and walks every merchant entry's nested items map, reading each item id.

Before insertion the loader resolves noted/certificate-style item redirects through ItemDefinition fields, except the exact excluded ids 995, 20693 and 20842, then stores the normalized id in one static integer set.

Client constructs and loads this class during startup. The only external live consumer checks the static set while rendering item-name text and, when the associated client config flag is enabled, appends exact marker '<img=370>' to matching item names.

The class owns no merchant rotation, price, stock or purchase behavior; exact v308 proves only the registry of item ids sourced from wandering_merchant config, so the name stops at WanderingMerchantItemRegistry.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the startup-loaded registry of item IDs present in wandering merchant configuration. It does not claim server-side merchant stock/rotation authority.
